Basically you're cutting with an ionized jet of superheated pressurized air. It's forced through the nozzle & around the electrode (cools the torch head) and goes through the arc that's established between the workpiece & the electrode. Metal melts instantly & is blown away.

Easy to learn to use properly, fast cutting speeds, cleaner cuts, low maintenance... more expensive than oxy-fuel to get setup.

You also need a decent compressor & air filter too. For 2" thick you're looking at industrial size power supplies.
